{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Recompute `converted` based on `status`: 1 if 'completed', 0 if 'refunded'
df['converted'] = (df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Verify the fix
check = (df['status'] == 'refunded') & (df['converted'] == 1)
if check.any():
    print('Error: Still have refunded with converted = 1')
else:
    print('Good: All refunded orders now have converted = 0')"}
